title: Anima: Scattered Light
description:
План развитияHello Community!

Over the past few months, I have been working tirelessly behind the scenes to completely rebuild and polish the core gameplay experience of Anima. Today, I am incredibly proud to announce that the Anima: Enhanced Edition Update is officially live!

As a solo developer, your early feedback meant the world to me. I took your notes to heart, and this massive overhaul addresses the game's core mechanics to deliver the fluid, premium experience you deserve.

Here is exactly what is new in today's update:

🎮 1. Enhanced Controls & Quality of LifeCombat, movement, and navigation now feel sharper and tighter than ever before.

• Input Enhancement: Your dodges and attacks now feel smooth, eliminating any clunky delays during high-intensity fights.

• Full Controller Support: New input system ensures your gamepads work flawlessly out of the box.

🎬 2. Cinematic & Visual OverhaulImmerse yourself deeper into the lore of the magical realms.

• Stunning New Cinematics: Key story beats and boss introductions have been completely redesigned with cinematic camera angles and dramatic pacing.

• Impact & Polish: Added hit effects and subtle camera shake to combat, making every magical strike feel incredibly powerful.

⚡ 3. Performance & Steam Deck OptimizationPlay smoothly, whether you are at your desktop or on the go.

• Massive Framerate Boosts: Optimized rendering pipelines ensure flawless performance, even during heavy boss encounters with multiple particle effects.

• Steam Deck Ready: UI scaling and font sizes have been adjusted for perfect readability on handheld screens.

🌍 4. Expanded LocalizationWe want players all over the world to experience the journey of Anima. The game now features full text localization for:

• French (Français)

• Spanish (Español)

• Japanese (日本語)

• Traditional Chinese (繁體中文)

• Simplified Chinese (简体中文)

🎁 A Special Thank You & Next StepsTo celebrate this massive milestone, Anima is now permanently available at a new, lower price to welcome new players into our community.

If you have been holding out, now is the absolute best time to dive back into the adventure of a lifetime.

If you enjoy the new update, please consider leaving a short Steam Review. As an indie developer, your reviews are the single most powerful tool to help other players discover the game.

Thank you for your incredible support, and have fun exploring the enhanced realms!

— Psi Studios

Об игреUncover the secrets of a shattered world. The fate of Anima is in your hands.Anima is an atmospheric, story-driven adventure that rewards curiosity, patience, and precision. Step into a world of interconnected realms, where progress isn't just about fighting. It's about understanding the environment, mastering platforming challenges, and piecing together a deep, unfolding narrative.

Features:

• Deep, Atmospheric Exploration: Traverse beautifully crafted, distinct environments. Search every corner to discover hidden keys, ancient secrets, and the lore of a world on the brink.

• Precision Platforming: Test your skills against environmental hazards and clever navigation puzzles. Every realm requires wit and agility to conquer.

• Earn Your Power: Discover crucial upgrades and special items hidden across the lands.

• Monolithic Boss Battles: While the journey is peaceful, the guardians of the realms are not. Save your strength for intense, tactical boss fights that protect the world's deepest secrets.

• Stunning Visuals & Smooth Gameplay: Immerse yourself in a striking aesthetic backed by fluid, responsive controls that make exploration a joy.

The path forward is yours to find. Discover the truth, overcome the trials, and determine the ultimate fate of the realms.

Play wisely.
description_short: An atmospheric, story-driven adventure rewarding curiosity and precision. Explore interconnected realms, conquer precision platforming, find hidden keys, and face tactical boss battles. The fate of Anima is in your hands. Play wisely.
